title: Hardware Prototyping Engineer – Wearables (m/f/d)
description:
Build the first working models of our next wearable.

What you'll do
- Assemble electronic and mechanical prototypes
- Create 3D-printed enclosures and test fits
- Run test series and log results with Python scripts

What you bring
- Bachelor's degree in mechatronics, electrical or mechanical engineering
- 1-3 years of prototyping or lab experience
- We support work-permit and relocation applications for non-EU candidates
- Working language is English
